asset: Hokkaido wooden bear / salmon v26 actual high-poly jaw + paw vertex sculpt
reviewer: ChatGPT direct vision of actual identical-camera v25/v26 Blender Cycles and independent trimesh geometry inspection

bear_anatomy_and_silhouette.reason: Heavy bear torso retains v25 silhouette; overall anatomy remains too geometric; no major improvement.

face_and_expression.reason: Raised lower jaw surface produces ragged tooth-like protrusion beneath the fish, a regression relative to v25's smoother lower rim.

salmon_shape_and_bite.reason: Fish body really compresses vertically by up to 0.059571 world units at central cross-section, but front and three-quarter views still do not show a convincing, enveloping anatomical bite.

carving_detail_and_wood.reason: Preserved v25 effective directional mesh-carved shoulder/back fur; still overly regular in patches.

paws_and_limbs.reason: All four paw-fronts show shallow three-toe divisions and somewhat improved tapered ankle geometry; limbs remain stiff, but this sculpt operation is useful.

multi_view_presentation.reason: Real GLB and identical 3D Cycles camera and light A/B captures verified; main bear and salmon are watertight connected meshes.

defects.finding: Jaw contact editing causes jagged, tooth-like bumps exposed below the fish, not a convincing bite; this version regresses visually around the mouth.
defects.required_fix: Do not reuse the positive lip-raise brush. Reconstruct an anatomically connected lower jaw with a stable side silhouette and actual contact profile; smooth/retopologize the mouth region while preserving a central fish waist.

defects.finding: The salmon still looks like a pale, tapering plank with overly simple head, fins, and a tiny point-eye. Waist constriction alone does not establish anatomical fish shape.
defects.required_fix: Reference-locked salmon head, gill profile, belly curve and tail peduncle, sculpt eye cavities directly on fish surface.

defects.finding: Three-toe divisions are now visible on all feet, especially in front orthographic, but linework remains shallow and whole limbs are cylindrical.
defects.required_fix: Preserve the toe groove method as a candidate, resculpt shoulder/ankle/paw silhouette before adding further claw detail.

defects.finding: Direction-following chisel fur is retained, yet some patterning looks regular; head and ears remain soft toy-like.
defects.required_fix: Vary stroke lengths anatomically and re-form eye-brow/ear shape against real wooden carving references.

reusable_assets: Retain v25 directional high-poly fur incision process
Retain v26 paw grooving test for future anatomy pass
Reject v26 jaw-lift formula and keep artifacts only as failed comparison
